paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.12a.12), in a halakhic ruling.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rava bar Kisna in its discussion of how large a share of a vineyard a sale conveys, and spells the name קסנא. Hyman’s heading spells it קיסנא.
